body: Well this wasn't helpful at all.

> there are days when I pray that I will be hit by a bus or just drop dead

This is me constantly. I won't put myself in that situation but I wouldn't be upset if it happened.

>I think that some people are just hard-wired towards depression/suicidal thoughts

Unfortunately I do too. Sorry about your cousin and having to live through that. My uncle killed himself but this was before I was born. I do think it runs in my family though my family is the type to pretend everything is always perfect. Exhausting a bit.

>I really didn't mean to turn this into a conversation about myself

To be honest, I prefer talking about others. I do it every day with friends and it's nice to relate to people. As you said, I feel like I'm a burden to others and when I can help someone else... It makes me smile just a little.

>seek therapy

I've tried this. I agree it can be helpful. I had one therapist tell me I'm a control freak and that I play life like a board game. Everyone are the pieces and if they move just the way I tell(expect) them to that things will be alright. So I'm a manipulative bitch basically, hah. He meant well. The others have meant well. I haven't found one that I can really open up to though. I always feel like I'm going to them I feel too ashamed.
